2nd of 16 (promoted) |website = {{url|https://chornomorets.ua|chornomorets.ua}} |pattern_b1 = _chornomorets2024-25_hm |pattern_la1 = |pattern_ra1 = |pattern_sh1 = |pattern_so1 = _chornomorets2024-25_hm |leftarm1 = 000000 |body1 = |rightarm1 = 000000 |shorts1 = 000000 |socks1 = 000000 |pattern_b2 = _chornomorets2023-24_away |pattern_la2 = _chornomorets2023-24_away |pattern_ra2 = _chornomorets2023-24_away |pattern_sh2 = |pattern_so2 = |leftarm2 = FFFFFF |body2 = FFFFFF |rightarm2 = FFFFFF |shorts2 = FFFFFF |socks2 = FFFFFF |current = 2026–27_FC_Chornomorets_Odesa_season }} '''FC Chornomorets Odesa''' ({{Langx|uk|Футбо́льний Клуб Чорномо́рець Оде́са}} {{IPA|uk|tʃornoˈmɔretsʲ oˈdɛsɐ|}}) is a Ukrainian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Odesa]], Ukraine. According to the club's website, it was formed in 1936 as ''Dynamo'',[https://chornomorets.ua/club/history_and_achievements A brief overview of the club's establishment at the official website] (in Ukrainian) but until 2002 it carried a logo with 1958 and 1959[https://web.archive.org/web/20180420184537/http://uht.org.ua/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=858 FC Chornomorets Odesa (ФК "Чорноморець" Одеса)]. [[Ukrainian Heraldry Society]] Forum. 27 June 2010 (in Ukrainian)[https://web.archive.org/web/20190904185543/http://www.kopanyi-myach.info/index.aspx?page=ua_clubvis&nc=4 Chornomorets Odesa]. Kopanyi-myach. (in Ukrainian) listed as the club's years of foundation on its shield, which is when the club received its current name. The club's shield is very similar to the shield of Romanian [[FC Farul Constanța]].[http://uht.org.ua/forum/viewtopic.php?f=49&t=388#p956 Plagiarism in sports emblems (Плагіат у спортивних емблемах)]. [[Ukrainian Heraldry Society]] Forum. 9 January 2010 (in Ukrainian) Chornomorets is the first club in the modern history of [[Ukraine]] to win the [[1992 Ukrainian Cup final|Ukrainian Cup (1992)]], and also repeated this success in the [[1994 Ukrainian Cup final|1993–94 season]]. For over 30 years, the club was sponsored by the [[Black Sea Shipping Company]] (1959–1991).[https://chornomorets.ua/club/history_and_achievements An overview of the club's history in 1958–1969 at the official website] {{in lang|uk}} The club was among top 20 Soviet clubs that competed in [[Soviet Top League]]. The club's home ground is [[Chornomorets Stadium]] and has been opened in 2011."}}
